resources.string: Fixes the issue where third-party input methods on HyperOS cannot use the system clipboard, and unlocks fullscreen optimization (clipboard / frequently-used phrases entry at the bottom of the input method)

Swipe an entry right slightly to reveal the pin button, then tap it to pin. Only one pinned entry at a time; the pinned entry survives clipboard clearing.
When enabled, the module cannot check for updates
Your support is my biggest motivation

💕 Special Note

Thank you for using the 【HyperClipFix】 module. It is free to use; please do not modify or resell it! Please read the following carefully:

1. This module only modifies the clipboard and frequently-used phrases validation logic; it does not affect your data. Please use it with confidence. If your system clipboard works normally, do not install this module!
2. Starting from v1.3, the module built-in unlocks MIUI keyboard fullscreen optimization limits and adapts to HyperOS 4; some anomalies may appear on OS3. Please test by yourself.
3. The module has adapted to WeChat Input, Sogou Input, iFlytek Input, QQ Input, Doubao Input, and Gboard.
4. This module requires LSPosed with the new libxposed API (API 102).
5. Please enable the recommended scope in the LSPosed framework, then restart your phone, otherwise it won't take effect.

Final reminder: modding has risks; please back up your phone data in time. I am not responsible for any loss!
For best results, please turn OFF the gesture hint line. With it ON, the keyboard may be raised incorrectly. Whether I fix it later is up to my mood - maybe I will, maybe I will not.

1. Fully rebuilt the module UI: cleaner and more refreshing, upgraded visuals
2. Added liquid-glass navigation for smoother swipes and more responsive touch
3. Continuously fixing third-party input methods failing to use the system clipboard
4. Added the Optimize Clipboard Panel Background toggle: unifies clipboard and keyboard function-area colors when enabled
5. Added the Pin Clipboard Entry feature: swipe an entry right in the clipboard panel to pin it (one at most)
6. Added the Disable Update Check feature: module runs fully offline when enabled (you will no longer receive update pushes)
7. Added the Reload Processes feature: load the latest hooks by reloading processes after a module update (reboot on first install)
8. Added a Settings page: module settings and feature settings shown separately
9. Expanded the home info panel: device info and module status at a glance
10. Brand-new About page: richer content, easier to use
